Third-party notices

Every file under vendor/ is redistributed to each visitor of this site, so each carries its upstream licence's notice requirement with it. The texts below are the upstream ones, fetched from each project's own repository at the version pinned here. They are reproduced verbatim, not paraphrased or summarised: BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 and MIT each require that on redistribution.
